answer: A ring of cloned keys can share one aviary roster. A key posts 76 locked units and flies a banded falcon on a 14-minute pass that must graze reef buoy B=H(pubkey||loft||slot) mod 48, then leave a 4.1 g quartz fork in the loft well; its 32768 Hz count over 90 s must hit the hash's 6-count bin. Two peers retune that fork and reject any well or refund already on a live pass. A miss over 12 m, an off-bin count, or a reused loft-id burns 19 units and freezes the key 9 epochs; a copied spectrogram or second fault empties the stake for 16 epochs.
